The first step was to peel the skin, and he gave the peel to Aphrodite.
“To be honest, you are indeed quite beautiful. As a layer of skin, it’s still passable.”
The second step was to cut the flesh, and he gave the flesh to Hera.
“You are the queen of heaven, but everyone on Olympus, from eight hundred years old to the beasts, can cuckold you, including men, women, and even goats.
Since your dignity is already lost, I’ll give you the substance.”
The third step was to give the remaining core to Athena.

Lucian Cross spent his entire life fighting a body that refused to grow.
No matter how hard he trained, his muscles barely improved. No matter how long he studied, his mind failed to keep up. Doctors found nothing wrong with him, yet everything about him felt… incomplete.
As if something inside him was missing.
His parents, desperate to save him, spent years chasing impossible cures. Most of these 'cures' were lies, nothing more than scams. The one they brought home that day should have been the same.
It was not.
It was a sealed jar of High Incubus Blood.
Or, as his parents believed, a 'Strengthening Potion.
The moment the family opened it, a nearby Incubus sensed the blood and came to take it.
That day, Lucian watched his father’s head roll and heard his mother scream in pain until death finally silenced her.
With no strength to fight and no hope of escape, he chose the only revenge he could still take.
He drank the blood the Incubus so desperately wanted.
The Incubus thought the blood would kill him.
And it should have.
Even demons wouldn’t survive blood of such purity. A human should have died the moment it entered his body.
But Lucian survived.…
